findings.text: The two nesting rules disagree. nesting/page.js:728 boxes levels 1–3 (the owner's "about 3 levels"), but log/LogView.js:233 boxes only levels 1–2, and log/page.js:583 tells the reader "Level 3 drops it". Pick one depth, and share one constant or helper so it can't drift again. card/readme.md:869 and card.css:70 call the two "the same choice", and right now they aren't.

The Log and Whisper pages open with a `page_work` task box that lists unrelated agent tasks ("Log in to Cloudflare?", "Chat log: scroll…", audio tasks). It pushes the actual demo below the fold at every width (…card-log/sheet.png, …card-log-whisper/sheet.png). The first thing a reader sees should be a live nested log. Move the task box to the bottom, or drop it (log/page.js:565, log/whisper/page.js:33).

The added ask from 2026-09-30 (the AI 2 Inbox tab, a Log view with status lights, no heartbeats) was not built. It was split off to next-log-view/requirements.md with a written reason and agreement from mastermind-servex-8. That is fine, but the task's landing report must say it plainly, so nobody reads this task as covering it.

Requirement 4 asks for JSONL output "where it should persist" (page.jsonl, ai/log.jsonl). Logger.js:324 leaves writing to the caller, and the only persistence anywhere is the Whisper page's "Download JSONL" button. Nothing writes to a real log file yet. That is acceptable for v1, but it is a gap against the requirement.

MiniPages.js:654 names its page.jsonl verb `card`, which collides with Page's own `card` property. The fix at :687 overrides `preview()` to patch it. Renaming the verb (for example `mini`) would be simpler and removes the trap instead of documenting it. The page skill's improvements.md already records the trap.

…core-Page/sheet.png: the Page top tab bar (Overview … Generator · API · Docs · Files) has no Cards tab. The new module is reachable only from the sidebar tree and the readme line, so check whether the tab list at core/Page/page.js needs `card` added.

…card/sheet.png at 1280: the four ground samples wrap 3 + 1, which leaves "Strong hue" alone on a second row. At 1920 and 3440 the four fit in one row with a lot of empty space to the right, and the preview wall below it also leaves most of the width blank at 3440. A `--column` near 14em, or a 4-up grid, would keep the set together.

…card-nesting/sheet.png and …card-headers/sheet.png: each demo shows its code block before its result. On Headers that means six stacked demos, each mostly code, and at 1280 the first rendered card only appears after scrolling. The nesting result, levels 4–5, which is the point of that page, is below the fold at every width. Showing the result first, or collapsing the code, would put the takeaway on screen.

headers/page.js:36 uses `href="#"` for the clickable card. Clicking it changes the URL to `…/headers/#`, which cuts against "route everything". A real child URL, such as a mini page, would make this demo actually show a routed card.

The rest looks sound: the four grounds reuse existing tokens, the dark-island `color` fix (card.css:51) is correct and well explained, the mini pages have real routes with no folders, as the owner decided, and the page-skill "Cards: which one, when" section is present.

findings.text: White text on the "Strong hue" ground (`.card-prim`, `var(--prim)`, orange) is about 2.5:1, below the 4.5:1 body-text floor and the 3:1 large-text floor (css 11). The `color-scheme: dark` island makes the ink light, and light ink on a light orange fails. See shots/…card-grounds/1920.png, the "STRONG HUE / var(--prim)" card, and shots/…card/1920.png, the "Strong hue" title. Give the strong-hue island dark ink, or use a darker primary step as its ground.

The Whisper page prints literal asterisks: "**read the actual log file for the whisper process.**" (shots/…card-log-whisper/1920.png, band 2). `p()` reads backticks, not markdown bold. Remove the `**`, or use a real `strong`.

The "Light gray" ground is `--wash`, which is also the page ground, so a `.card-gray` placed straight on the page paints nothing (css 14). Two examples: shots/…card-mini-pages/400.png, "The decision" card, which shows only as a faint outline, and shots/…card/1920.png, where "Light gray" matches the page. It reads only inside a white demo frame. Either the doc/system.md table says "light gray only on a white ground", or the ground needs a darker step on the page.

The first demo on Log is empty until someone clicks a button (shots/…card-log/sheet.png, top band at every width). A nested log you can see first appears in the second demo, below the fold at 1920. Pre-running one `increment()` would put a live group on screen. The Whisper log is empty in the same way until you press Start, which is fine because that demo needs the server.
On the Cards index at 1920, the preview wall ends 4 + 2, leaving two blank tracks on the right (layout 11) — shots/…card/1920.png, band 3. At 1200 (2 + 2 + 2) and 3440 (6 in one row) it is balanced.

The core/Page tab bar still takes tab_rows 2 at 1920, 3 at 1200 and 6 at 400 (layout.json). That misses page 14. It is not this task's bar and was already relayed (reply.md 6). The only line this diff adds to it is `card` in `children`.
